metadata.schema_version: v1.1 (honest Galileo-era data: CMR2 + synodic support cut; k2/h2 as LABELED hypothetical-conditioning channels)
metadata.description: Europa Galileo v1.1 (honest re-run, user 2026-07-19). Corrects the v1 defect: v1 conditioned on Titan-derived k2 sigmas (0.06 ~ Cassini-Titan scale) as if Europa had a measured k2 — but Galileo measured NEITHER k2 NOR h2. v1.1 honest data = CMR2 [0.3547, 0.0024] (GC21 MoI, Galileo-derived) + the synodic |Ae|>0.7 induction support cut. k2/h2 RETAINED as HYPOTHETICAL-CONDITIONING channels with theory-motivated WIDE widths (Re_k2 0.23+/-0.05 spanning the 0.2-0.3 ocean-consistent theory range, Im_k2 0.004+/-0.05, Re_h2 1.2+/-0.1, Im_h2 0+/-0.1), defaulted at the ocean-consistent theory point. These express hypothetical tidal data for GUI exploration; NO Galileo-era measurement exists. Everything else as v1 (7 params, Test51 1D cache, synodic-only induction). Plan: plans/europa-clipper-v4-geodesy-plan.md ('Galileo v1.1 re-run' section).
metadata.primary_constraint: CMR2 from Gomez Casajus et al. (2021) + synodic |Ae|>0.7 support cut. This is the ONLY honest Galileo-era data.
metadata.k2_status_2026_07_19: HYPOTHETICAL-CONDITIONING CHANNELS, NOT MEASUREMENTS. Galileo measured no k2/h2. Re_k2 0.23+/-0.05 (central = ocean-consistent theory, Moore & Schubert 2000; sigma 0.05 spans the 0.2-0.3 ocean-case theory range), Im_k2 0.004+/-0.05, Re_h2 1.2+/-0.1, Im_h2 0+/-0.1. The GUI scope note MUST label these 'no Galileo-era measurement exists; hypothetical tidal data for exploration, defaults at the ocean-consistent theory point.' Alternative (REJECTED, documented): dropping k2/h2 entirely is the strictly-honest Galileo dataset but leaves 7 params constrained by one observable + a support cut => prior-dominated posterior and the GUI demo loses its purpose. USER may override to the drop-channels variant before training (user chose RETAIN, 2026-07-19).
metadata.v1_defect_2026_07_19: The retired v1 artifact (europa_seawater_andrade_posterior_1m.pt, europa_seawater_andrade_8D.json) conditioned on Re_k2 0.25+/-0.06, Im_k2 0+/-0.06 -- sigma 0.06 is the Cassini-Titan scale, not a Europa measurement (Europa has NO measured k2). v1.1 replaces the fake-measurement framing with honest hypothetical-conditioning labels + wider theory sigmas. v1 INDEX row -> retired.
metadata.core_bounds_rationale: R_core in [0, 0.5 R_body]; rho_core in [5000, 8000] kg/m^3 (metallic Fe / Fe-S); rho_sil derived from M_total mass conservation, samples outside [2200, 3500] kg/m^3 rejected.
metadata.Tb_bounds_rationale: Tb_K=[259.5, 271.0] K targets D_iceIh=[~3, ~100] km; see europa_seawater_andrade_8D.json.
metadata.induction_bounds_rationale: Galileo synodic induction treated as one-sided support cuts, NOT Gaussian observables (user 2026-07-12): |Ae_synodic| > 0.7 and |Im(Ae_synodic)| < 0.4. Because Ae depends only on Tb via the cached conductivity profile, each bound is exactly a Tb-support cut; hard rejection in the MCMC likelihood, training-time row rejection in SBI. Surviving support Tb in [~261.5, 271.0] K.
metadata.plan_reference: plans/europa-clipper-v4-geodesy-plan.md ('Galileo v1.1 re-run + Europa slot retirement', user 2026-07-19). Full gate suite vs a re-run reference MCMC with these same corrected observables.
metadata.zeta_split_2026_07_19: log10_zeta split into log10_zeta_Ih (ice Ih) and log10_zeta_sil (silicate), both U[-3, 2] (user 2026-07-19): a SINGLE sampled zeta couples the Andrade transient-creep amplification of ice and rock, so any zeta raised to fit ice dissipation (Im k2) simultaneously amplifies silicate dissipation - systematically preferencing silicate heating in the posterior heating budget. Independent zetas let the data set each. No HP-ice zeta: the Europa Tb box has no III/V/VI layers. Forward-model hook apply_andrade_params already supports per-phase zeta (log10_zeta_Ih/log10_zeta_sil override precedence).
